Package com.sca4d.core.spring.gateway

Class GatewayRegistrationProperties

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.core.spring.gateway.GatewayRegistrationProperties
@ConfigurationProperties("sca4dj.gateway.registration") public class GatewayRegistrationProperties extends Object
保存应用实例向 Gateway 注册 HTTP 路由和回调所需的运行参数。
